findings.text: Soluk soluğa koşu, kıvılcım, baskın, toz ve merkeze giriş zincirini harekete geçirir; duyulan soluk da bu hareketin bedensel maliyetini gösterir.
Koşu, yalnız hız değil, düşmanlık taşıyan bir sınır aşımı olarak da belirir.
Soluk sesi, sonraki kıvılcım ve tozla birlikte sürtünmeden doğan ısı, kararma ve külün ilk maddi evresi gibi okunabilir.
Dıştaki koşu, insanın mala şiddetli bağlılığında içe taşınan bulaşıcı bir sürüklenme kalıbını önceden gösterir.
Hareket, kenar boyunca ilerleyip topluluğun merkezine ulaşan mekânsal bir manevranın başlangıcıdır.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the main locomotor event.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Running and hastening.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Turns invisible exertion into an acoustic signal.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A cry or audible breath-sound, including horses' breathing while running.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Gives the sound a matching bodily geometry.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Running with the forelegs stretched.

changed_reading.after: Those whose rapid forward extension becomes audible as forced breath.
changed_reading.before: An unspecified sworn plural marked only by motion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَٰدِيَٰتِ supplies rapid running, while ضَبْحًا supplies both the audible breath and the bodily gait of that running.
baseline_models.mechanism: A plural body in rapid motion stretches forward and forces breath through mouth and chest; the second word makes exertion audible rather than merely naming speed.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the boundary-violating function.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Crossing a limit into injustice or aggression.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Keeps a non-moral spatial threshold model beside the aggressive one.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Passing beyond something or turning from it to another.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes hostile purpose possible without making it compulsory.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Enemy relation and enmity.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Registers the cost of forcing the boundary.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Audible breath under exertion.

changed_reading.after: Boundary-crossers whose overrun is heard in their breath, with hostile and non-hostile crossing still coexisting.
changed_reading.before: Fast runners.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dominant ع د و inventory allows عَٰدِيَٰتِ to carry overstepping, hostile relation, and passage beyond a limit; ضَبْحًا keeps that crossing embodied.
baseline_models.mechanism: Running is read functionally as the act that carries an agent across a boundary. The panting is then the bodily cost or audible signature of overrun, not a neutral speed effect.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Turns linear motion into a recurrent circuit.
activation_trace.branch_image_ar: رجوع بعد انصراف وتثنية بعد بدء
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A return after departure and a second pass after a beginning.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies learned, repeated service rather than a one-off burst.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Habit, trained familiarity, and persistence.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Adds endurance and expenditure over time.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: An aged working animal with strength still remaining.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes repeated service physiologically costly.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Audible breath-sound.

changed_reading.after: Practised returners repeatedly spending their remaining strength until service is audible.
changed_reading.before: A single episode of running.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of عَٰدِيَٰتِ to ع و د activates return, habituation, and an aged worker's remaining strength; ضَبْحًا supplies the exertion that repeated service costs.
baseline_models.mechanism: The plural can be heard not only as runners but as practised returners: repeated work has become disposition, yet each cycle remains bodily expensive.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes the plural a series of discernible units.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Enumerating a countable thing.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies premeditated readiness.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Preparing equipment, reserve, or readiness for an event.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Provides serial ordering through time.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Successive pursuit, one target following another in a single run.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Synchronizes the prepared units into one forward sequence.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A stretched running gait.

changed_reading.after: Prepared, countable units advancing successively in a coordinated run.
changed_reading.before: A plural crowd running.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split ع د د mapping supplies enumeration and prepared equipment, while the dominant ع د و inventory supplies successive pursuit; ضَبْحًا coordinates the units through one extended gait.
baseline_models.mechanism: The plural is reconstructed as a prepared, countable series rather than an undifferentiated mass. Successive units follow in one run, each contributing a pulse of movement and breath.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies kinetic input.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Rapid running.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies a possible heat-effect.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Scorching the upper part of wood or what fire touches.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes the effect visible on a surface.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Slight blackening by fire or sun.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies a possible terminal residue.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Ash.

changed_reading.after: Running with a latent material arc from heat-touch to blackening and ash.
changed_reading.before: Running registered only as sound and gait.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ضَبْحًا has explicit scorching, blackening, and ash branches alongside its breath branch; عَٰدِيَٰتِ supplies the energetic movement that could precede such material effects.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can carry a dormant thermo-material reading: rapid movement is not only heard but leaves matter heat-touched. The direction from motion to scorching is a provisional reader inference, not supplied by the focus alone.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies resistant terrain.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Hard, dry, or uneven ground.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the seasonal ecology.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Summer growth after spring has passed.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies a recurrent route.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: An old or ancient road.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Registers environmental strain.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Audible breath under exertion.

changed_reading.after: Habitual seasonal travelers panting along an old route over hard summer ground.
changed_reading.before: An unlocated sprint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَٰدِيَٰتِ can activate hard uneven ground, summer herbage, and an old route through its split inventories; ضَبْحًا makes travel across that terrain bodily audible.
baseline_models.mechanism: A seasonal travel circuit is possible: habitual movers traverse an old, hard route after spring, breathing under environmental strain. This remains form-distant but is internally functional rather than a loose list of landscape images.

alternatives: The two ayat could present adjacent but causally independent oath images.
The scorch branch of ضَبْحًا could be only lexical resonance while breath remains primary.
abductive_moves.assumption: The parallel constructions describe linked phases of one event-chain.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Running and scorching branches in 100:1; latent fire and striking branches in 100:2; sequential فَ.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: Rapid contact or exertion in the focus is the energy that releases the latent fire in the next phase.

context_deltas.ablation: Without 100:2's latent-fire and striking branches, the focus still permits scorching but no longer supplies a credible conversion mechanism from running to ignition.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Acts as the inferred upstream energy.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Rapid kinetic motion.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Provides the focus-level material bridge to ignition.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Wood becoming scorched where fire touches it.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies hidden potential becoming manifest.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Latent fire emerging from the fire-stick.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the conversion mechanism from contact to flame.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Kindling fire by striking.

changed_reading.after: Kinetic agents whose exertion begins a motion-to-ignition chain; breath and heat remain co-present.
changed_reading.before: Panting runners with a weak, isolated scorch possibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The latent scorch reading of ضَبْحًا becomes a process model. The focus supplies rapid motion and scorchable heat-effect; 100:2 supplies fire hidden in a striker and its successful emergence through striking. I infer, but the packet does not state, the arrow motion or repeated contact → ignition.
structural_cues: 100:1 and 100:2 repeat a feminine plural active-participle frame followed by an accusative event noun.
Initial فَ in 100:2 presents the ignition image as a next phase rather than an unrelated inventory item.

alternatives: Dawn may only date an action without being transformed by it.
The change branch may resonate without defining مُغِيرَٰتِ in this construction.
abductive_moves.assumption: The change branch of مُغِيرَٰتِ can qualify the effect of the same moving plurality introduced in 100:1.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Passing-beyond in the focus, changed form in 100:3, dawn as first light, and a repeated participial frame.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The motion transports or precipitates a night-to-dawn transformation.

context_deltas.ablation: Removing either the change image or dawn leaves generic boundary-crossing; their conjunction is what yields a temporal phase transition.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Anchors the change as a crossing performed by the focus agents.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Passing beyond one thing toward another.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies a state transition, not merely location change.
activation_trace.branch_image_ar: تغيير الصورة أو إبدال الشيء بغيره
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Changing a form or replacing one thing with another.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Locates the transition at a visible temporal threshold.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Dawn and the first part of day.

changed_reading.after: Agents crossing and changing a temporal state, with hostile overrun still available but no longer exhaustive.
changed_reading.before: Agents crossing a spatial or moral limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The boundary-crossing baseline becomes temporal and transformative. عَٰدِيَٰتِ still supplies passing beyond; 100:3 adds altered form and first light. The runners can therefore be read as carrying an event across a phase boundary, from one state of the scene into another at dawn.
structural_cues: A third parallel feminine plural participle extends the same agent-sequence.
The temporal accusative صُبْحًا changes the scale of crossing from a local boundary to a phase boundary.

alternatives: Breath and dust may be independent descriptive details.
The non-dominant trace mapping may be only a form-distant echo.
abductive_moves.assumption: Acoustic breath and visible dust belong to one cross-sensory residue system.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Breath-sound in 100:1, visible rising/spreading and dust in 100:4, and a remaining-mark branch in the split mapping.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The focus is an event known through what it emits and leaves behind.

context_deltas.ablation: Without the non-dominant remaining-mark image, dust is only an effect; without the dust image, breath alone is too transient to establish a trail.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the event that leaves residues behind.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Rapid passage.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Acts as the first, acoustic trace of otherwise passing motion.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Audible breath.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Converts contact with terrain into an expanding visible field.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A thing rising and spreading visibly.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Reclassifies the raised material as evidence of prior passage.
activation_trace.branch_image_ar: علامة باقية تدل على ما كان
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A remaining mark indicating what had been.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the durable, visible residue of the running.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A cloud of raised dust.

changed_reading.after: A passage reconstructed from emitted breath and a spreading material trail that survives the bodies' passing.
changed_reading.before: Running bodies directly perceived in the instant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus agents become trace-producing bodies. Breath is the first short-lived residue; later motion raises and spreads dust, while the non-dominant ء ث ر mapping activates a lasting mark that points backward to what passed. The packet supplies motion, spread, dust, and mark; I infer that these residues form one evidentiary trail.
structural_cues: The shift from repeated participles to a finite plural verb makes an effect issue from the moving plurality.
The pronoun in بِهِۦ structurally invites, but does not settle, a causal link between prior motion and the raised material.
The split mapping ث و ر → ء ث ر preserves both production of dust and interpretation of dust as trace.

alternatives: A loose group could happen to reach a middle without prior formation.
The split preparedness mapping may be resonance rather than a property of the surface form.
abductive_moves.assumption: The same plurality that pants in 100:1 is organized enough to act as a formation in 100:5.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Prepared/readied and successive branches in the focus; entry into the middle and gathered-force branches in 100:5.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The units coordinate their timing to penetrate a collective center.

context_deltas.ablation: Without the middle-entry branch, preparation has no destination; without gathered-force, entry need not be coordinated.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies advance preparation.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Prepared equipment and readiness.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies ordered arrival rather than random crowding.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Successive pursuit in a single run.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the penetration geometry and destination.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Entering or placing something in the middle.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Converts serial units into concentrated force.
activation_trace.branch_image_ar: استجماع القوة أو السير حتى تتلاحق أجزاؤه
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Gathering force or motion until its parts catch up with one another.

changed_reading.after: A timed formation concentrating its parts to enter the middle of a gathered body.
changed_reading.before: Prepared units moving successively.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prepared-succession baseline gains a destination and formation geometry. Countable, readied runners do not merely move together: they enter the middle of a gathered body while their separate units gather force into one advance.
structural_cues: The plural finite verb maintains the plurality introduced in the focus.
وسط plus جمع supplies a center-versus-group relation, giving the motion a target topology.
The repeated بِهِۦ after 100:4 supports continuity of instrument or cause, though its exact antecedent is not resolved here.

alternatives: The opening may illustrate power or attack rather than service.
The non-dominant ع و د branches may remain only latent wordplay.
abductive_moves.assumption: The opening motion-sequence is contrastive evidence for the human proposition rather than merely scenery before it.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Habituated return and benefit branches in the focus; human, nurture, cutting, and denial branches in 100:6.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The panting plurality exemplifies costly, reliable return, exposing the human's failure to return received good.

context_deltas.ablation: Without the nurture-versus-cutting relation in 100:6, habituated return remains a work-cycle but no longer becomes a moral contrast.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies dependable repeated service.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Habit, training, and persistent engagement.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Frames exertion as benefit delivered back to another.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A benefit or kindness that returns to someone.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes the cost of service perceptible.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Audible exertional breath.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Introduces the accountable human pole of the contrast.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: The visible human as distinct from wildness or the unseen.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the prior care to which a response would be due.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Models ingratitude as severing a relation or return-flow.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Cutting and separation.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Names the failed response to received nurture.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Denial of favor and affection.

changed_reading.after: Practised bearers of benefit whose audible expenditure throws human severance and ingratitude into relief.
changed_reading.before: Runners expending themselves in an unspecified task.

context_deltas.mechanism: The abrupt human proposition activates the non-dominant habituation and returned-benefit branches of عَٰدِيَٰتِ. The focus plurality can now function as a contrastive image of trained expenditure and benefit, set against the human who cuts the bond and denies nurture. The packet supplies the two poles; I infer the contrast between them.
structural_cues: 100:6 breaks from the kinetic plural sequence into an emphatic general statement about the human.
The possessive relation لِرَبِّهِۦ places human conduct inside a giver-or-nurturer relation.
The contrast is functional: repeated expenditure and returned benefit versus cutting and denial.

alternatives: The witness in 100:7 may be personal consciousness alone.
The opening signs may illustrate the proposition without themselves being witnesses.
abductive_moves.assumption: A bodily or environmental sign can serve as the witness named later.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Breath-sound, a remaining trace, presence-with-seeing, and a witnessing sign.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The opening agents testify by involuntary emissions and effects before any verbal testimony occurs.

context_deltas.ablation: Without the witnessing-sign branch, residues remain clues for an observer but do not themselves acquire testimonial status.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Functions as involuntary embodied evidence.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Audible breath-sound.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Extends testimony from the body into the environment.
activation_trace.branch_image_ar: علامة باقية تدل على ما كان
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A remaining sign that indicates a prior event.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the witnessing relation.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Presence together with seeing.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Allows breath and trail to count as witnesses, not just symptoms.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A sign that itself bears witness.

changed_reading.after: Panting and trail as a distributed testimony: body and terrain disclose what occurred.
changed_reading.before: Panting and dust as sensory effects of speed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The residual-trail model becomes testimony. The focus breath is an involuntary bodily mark, the dust/trace points backward to passage, and 100:7 supplies both present witnessing and a sign that bears witness. The verse can therefore be read as swearing by bodies that testify through what exertion makes them emit.
structural_cues: The emphatic witness clause follows the explicit human judgment of 100:6.
A sign-bearing branch in 100:7 reclassifies the earlier acoustic and material residues as evidence.
The non-dominant trace mapping in 100:4 and the witness-sign branch in 100:7 converge on the same evidentiary function.

alternatives: The opening movement may remain literal and only contrast with human desire.
Severity may describe degree without supplying a causal motor.
abductive_moves.assumption: The opening kinetics can image the later human motive.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Running in the focus; heart-bound love, useful good, tightened bond, intensified charge, and stinginess in 100:8.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: Attachment converts perceived benefit into urgent pursuit and then into withholding.

context_deltas.ablation: Without the run-specific severity branch, the link to 100:1 becomes merely thematic love; without heart-attachment, the motion lacks an inner motor.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the outward kinetics of desire.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Running and hastening.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies persistent inward attachment.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Love adhering to the heart.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the desired target as perceived benefit.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Inclination toward useful good.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Models attachment as constriction and capture.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Tightening a knot or bond.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Provides an explicit kinetic echo back to عَٰدِيَٰتِ.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Intensifying a charge or run.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Shows the motion ending in possessive retention rather than open return.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Intensity of stinginess.

changed_reading.after: A bodily diagram of desire: inward attachment tightens, accelerates pursuit of perceived good, and can terminate in withholding.
changed_reading.before: External agents rushing toward an unspecified objective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The physical charge in 100:1 becomes an enacted model of attachment. Love stays in the heart, perceived good supplies the object, and severity both binds and intensifies a charge or run. I infer an analogy: desire moves the human as forcefully as the opening plurality moves through terrain.
structural_cues: 100:8 retains the emphatic human description introduced in 100:6.
The branch image شد الحملة والعدو directly echoes the running function of the focus without requiring identity of referents.
Heart-attachment, useful good, tightened bond, and intensified run form a motive-to-motion mechanism.

alternatives: Return may be only a split-root echo with no role in the surface construction.
The overturning scene can follow the running sequence without changing its vector.
abductive_moves.assumption: The return branch can describe the macro-trajectory activated by the later disclosure scene.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Return and destination branches in the focus; disclosure, overturned earth, and obscurity branches in 100:9.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The opening forward rush is nested inside a larger departure-and-return cycle ending in exposure.

context_deltas.ablation: Without the overturning of a lowered concealed state, return remains an abstract recurrence rather than a directional reversal.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Folds the outward charge into a return trajectory.
activation_trace.branch_image_ar: رجوع بعد انصراف وتثنية بعد بدء
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Return after departure.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Gives the movement a terminal horizon.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Destination, point of return, or place/time returned to.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the epistemic result of return.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A thing becoming disclosed to the knower.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the reversal from below and hidden to above and exposed.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Overturning soil and exposing what was buried.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Defines the hidden condition that the reversal defeats.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A thing's obscurity and lowered state.

changed_reading.after: The outbound phase of a larger return-to-destination cycle in which concealed states are reversed into disclosure.
changed_reading.before: A one-way forward charge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-dominant return and destination branches of عَٰدِيَٰتِ become structurally consequential when concealed contents are overturned and disclosed. Forward rushing is no longer purely outbound: the larger sequence bends motion toward a return in which what was lowered and hidden comes back into exposure.
structural_cues: The conditional-interrogative turn in 100:9 shifts from present conduct to a future or hypothetical disclosure-event.
Passive overturning reverses the opening's outward horizontal vector with an upward exposure from concealment.
The split ع د و → ع و د inventory supplies return without erasing the dominant running reading.

alternatives: Panting may reveal exertion but not motive.
The extraction language may concern only the later human interior.
abductive_moves.assumption: Audible breath can be treated as a partial extraction or leakage of inner state.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Breath-sound in 100:1; bodily chest, origin of acts, and extraction of a core in 100:10.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: Panting involuntarily publishes the hidden expenditure and motive behind the run.

context_deltas.ablation: Without the chest and source-of-actions branches, breath still signals fatigue but no longer participates in the surah's inside-to-outside disclosure mechanism.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Acts as interior pressure crossing the body's boundary.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Breath or mouth-sound under running.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the outside-from-inside disclosure operation.
activation_trace.branch_image_ar: استخراج اللب أو النفيس من غلافه
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Extracting the core or precious part from its covering.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Locates the breath's hidden source in the body.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: The bodily chest and what is connected to it.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Connects outward running to an inward motive or source.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: The origin from which acts issue.

changed_reading.after: Breath as the body's involuntary opening: an interior source becomes audible through the exertion it generates.
changed_reading.before: Breath as an external accompaniment to running.

context_deltas.mechanism: ضَبْحًا is re-read as an inside becoming audible outside. 100:10 supplies the chest, the source from which acts issue, and extraction of a valuable core from its covering. The opening pant is therefore not decorative sound: it is involuntary disclosure of the interior state that produces motion.
structural_cues: The coordinated passive disclosures of 100:9-10 move from what is under earth to what is inside chests.
ضَبْحًا is a bodily emission, so the chest cue changes its function more directly than a broad thematic analogy would.
The source-of-actions branch makes outer motion diagnostically related to inner origin.

alternatives: The final knowledge may apply only to the later human material.
The focus's return-benefit mapping may remain an exploratory echo.
abductive_moves.assumption: The final knowledge clause retroactively changes how the opening expenditure is viewed.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: Practised return and returned benefit in the focus; repeated nurture relation and knowledge of inward reality at 100:11.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: The panting action is legible not only as output but as service with an inwardly known orientation.

context_deltas.ablation: Without the inward-knowledge branch, the opening can illustrate service but its hidden orientation is not brought under explicit assessment.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies sustained service visible in action.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Practised, persistent engagement.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies the return-flow whose presence or absence can be assessed.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Benefit or kindness returned to someone.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Restates the sustaining side of the relation at closure.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Nurturing, repairing, and completing.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Supplies knowledge of both outward performance and inward source.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Knowledge of the report and the inward reality of a matter.

changed_reading.after: Visible expenditure and hidden orientation held together as a fully known service relation.
changed_reading.before: A contrast between visible service and human ingratitude inferred by the reader.

context_deltas.mechanism: The service-versus-ingratitude reading closes as an assessed relation. The focus's practised return and returned benefit stand before the nurturer who knows the inward reality of the matter. This does not identify the runners; it changes their expenditure from spectacle into a legible act whose source and return are known.
structural_cues: رَبّ recurs at 100:6 and 100:11, framing the human diagnosis with the same relation.
The final inward-knowledge image follows the extraction of what is in chests.
The return-benefit branch of the focus gives the frame a reciprocal axis without claiming lexical identity.

discarded_or_unchanged: Proper-name, animal-name, utensil, tooth, drinking-vessel, and honey images did not produce a functional mechanism that returned to عَٰدِيَٰتِ or ضَبْحًا.
Bare repetitions of motion, morning, gathering, strength, presence, or knowledge were left unchanged unless they altered sequence, causation, evidentiary status, or the inside-to-outside relation.
No reading was discarded merely because it used a non-dominant mapped root; branch-distant activations that produced a genuine changed reading remain explicitly contained above.

hermeticity.limitations: This is a reconstructed one-call trace because focus and context arrived in the same sealed packet, not a strict staged blind-reveal log. It uses only the authorized prompt, schema, and packet; it makes no claim to identify the referent of the feminine plural participle or to select one final reading.
hermeticity.method: I first reconstructed focus-only possibilities from 100:1 and its two focus branch inventories, then evaluated the context root cues in packet order as activators, revisers, weakeners, or non-changes. Distinct mechanisms remain separate even when they compete.

remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not identify the referent of عَٰدِيَٰتِ, so mechanisms should not be converted into a single zoological, military, human, or cosmic identification.

Several causal arrows—motion to ignition, residues to testimony, opening kinetics to human desire, and service to moral contrast—are reader inferences explicitly distinguished from supplied branch images.

The return, count, ecological, transmitted-fire, and rising-breath readings depend on non-dominant or branch-distant mappings and should remain exploratory rather than be normalized into the surface sense.
The fire and ash branches may be literal material phases, cross-ayah resonance, or analogical commentary; the packet does not disambiguate their level.
The context supports both violent penetration and reparative redress, so social valence remains genuinely plural.
strongest_changes: 100:2 turns ضَبْحًا's isolated scorch branch into a kinetic ignition process while preserving audible breath.
100:4 and 100:7 turn breath and dust from sensory decoration into a distributed evidentiary trail and embodied witness.
100:6 activates a service-versus-ingratitude contrast through habituated return, returned benefit, nurture, cutting, and denial.
100:8 makes the opening charge a possible bodily diagram of desire: attachment tightens into accelerated pursuit and withholding.
100:9-10 bend outward motion toward return and reclassify panting as an interior source becoming audible outside.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained multiply active: literal locomotion, hostile or neutral boundary-crossing, prepared formation, habituated service, material ignition, seasonal travel, desire, testimony, and return all coexist. Split mappings were especially productive rather than disposable: ع د و → ع و د supplied recurrence and benefit, ع د و → ع د د supplied preparation and countability, ث و ر → ء ث ر supplied residual evidence, and ر ب ب → ر ب و supplied a contained rising-breath echo.

discarded_or_unchanged: و ر ي/B005-B008 concealment, behindness, descendants, and creation did not add a sharper focus-anchored mechanism than the fire emergence branches.
ق د ح/B002-B010 supplied interesting side images such as defect, cup, arrow-lot, and deliberation, but they either repeated striking-contact weakly or lacked a changed reading anchored in 100:1.
ص ب ح/B003-B010 mostly stayed as morning sub-branches or unrelated lexical material; B001 was sufficient for the threshold mechanism.
ث و ر/B004-B007 and ن ق ع/B003/B006-B009 were left aside because bull, curd, place-name, poison, and insult images did not visibly change the focus ayah.
ء ن س branches other than the human/interior transition were not retained; they named perception or sociability but did not alter the reading of عَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًا.
ر ب و under ر ب ب was not retained; increase, high ground, and breathing-swelling were suggestive but weaker than the ربوبية/authority and nurture branches for this focus.
خ ي ر branches were treated structurally as the object of love; none was needed as a separate focus-changing branch beyond the moral mirror.
Animal, plant, vessel, and proper-name branches in several roots were not discarded for oddness alone, but because no distinct anchored changed reading survived.

hermeticity.limitations: The packet gives the focus ayah and full local context at once, so this is a reconstructed hermetic focus trace rather than a staged blind discovery log; no sources beyond the prompt, schema, and packet were used.
hermeticity.method: Focus-only baselines were formed from 100:1 and its branch inventories, then context_root_cues were evaluated in packet order as activators or revisers.

remaining_uncertainties: How much weight downstream prose should give the non-dominant ع د د and ع و د mapped roots.
Whether the juridical redress branch of ع د و should be rendered explicitly or kept as latent support for witness/expert language.

strongest_changes: 100:2 revises ضَبْحًا from breath alone into breath-plus-ignition through hidden fire and striking.
100:4-5 turns running into a trace-making penetration of a gathered center.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Kinetic charge as boundary-crossing aggression.** Evidence: ع د و B002 running/hastening, B001 overstepping into injustice, B003 enemy/enmity; ض ب ح B001 breath-sound of running horses and B002 stretched-foreleg running. Structural cue: initial oath begins with bodies in motion and breath, then 100:3 names a morning raid and 100:5 an entry into a جمع. Role: عدو supplies speed and hostile crossing; ضبح makes the action audible and animal-bodied. Abductive move: the panting is not neutral locomotion but the sound of a force crossing into contested space. Reading change: the ayah reads as an embodied threshold breach, not simply a description of fast runners.

2. **Contagious condition of drive.** Evidence: ع د و B006 contagion/transmission and B007 hindrances; ض ب ح B001 repeated breath/cry; later ح ب ب B002 clinging love and ش د د B002 intensity. Structural cue: the opening motion becomes moral diagnosis in 100:6-8. Role: "running" becomes a transmissible pattern: driven desire passes from scene to human interior. Abductive move: the packet invites analogy between external gallop and internal compulsion. Reading change: the panting runners prefigure a human soul infected by severe attachment, making 100:1 a motor-image for later appetite.

3. **Along-edge approach.** Evidence: ع د و B009 side/bank/along-edge stretch, B010 hard uneven ground; ض ب ح B002 light or stretched running; later و س ط B003 entering the middle. Structural cue: the sequence runs from edge movement to center penetration. Role: عدو marks movement along a flank or boundary; وسط later reverses it by entry into the middle. Abductive move: a successful incursion first traces the edge before cutting into the center. Reading change: the ayah becomes the beginning of a spatial maneuver, not merely a generic chase.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 100:8 surprisingly returned the opening run inside the human: ش د د B003 and حب as clinging made the panting motion a figure for inward compulsion. 100:5 also clarified the spatial path: 100:1 begins at speed/edge, while 100:5 completes the maneuver in the center.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Exertion as the propulsion of a causal sequence.** `ع د و B002` supplies running and hastening, while `ض ب ح B001` supplies the audible breath or mouth-sound of horses in motion. The participial runner plus the accusative breath-image is immediately continued by sparks, dawn arrival, raised dust, and penetration in 100:2-5. Running is the mover and breath is its measurable cost. The packet gives the ordered effects; I infer that exertive motion enables the impacts that follow. The fixed ayah thus reads as the engine of the sequence, not as a static picture of speed.

2. **A coexisting boundary-crossing reading.** `ع د و B001` names overstepping a bound into aggression, and `ع د و B004` names passing beyond. The later morning-raid branch at `ص ب ح B004` in 100:3 and entry into the middle of a gathered body in 100:5 turn linear running into crossed perimeter and breached center. The packet does not label the crossing morally; the arrow from spatial breach to possible transgression is my inference. The runners can therefore remain literal runners while also reading as agents whose motion exceeds a boundary.

3. **Breath as the first material stage of scorching.** Alongside its sound sense, `ض ب ح B003` carries scorching of wood or striker-stones, `B004` blackening, and `B005` ash. Those dormant images are activated when 100:2 produces hidden fire by striking and 100:4 produces an airborne particulate cloud. I infer, rather than receive from the packet, a single frictional chain from exertion through ignition to dark residue. `ضَبْحًا` can then register not only panting but the incipient heat and residue generated by the charge.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 100:6 corrects the tempting transgression reading. The explicit negative diagnosis, `ك ن د B002`, attaches to the human there, not to the runners here, so `ع د و B001` must remain an exploratory boundary-crossing overlay rather than a settled moral identity. By contrast, 100:2 and 100:4 strengthen the material surprise: striking fire and raised particulate make the scorching and ash branches of `ض ب ح` genuinely functional in the sequence.

words.gloss_range: oath-opening particle, not ordinary coordination here; it governs the following genitive oath object and compresses an oath formula into one initial letter
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the surah as an oath particle rather than a simple connector. It makes the next word the sworn-by object, leaves the oath verb compressed, and starts a five-clause oath sequence (100:1-5) whose answer arrives later (100:6). Because the particle is joined in recitation to {{ar:ٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-'ādiyāti}}), the grammar and sound both launch the rushing image as one tight oath unit.

words.gloss_range: the definite feminine plural active participle naming the charging or running ones as an oath object; the local sense selects kinetic motion while retaining an adversarial and boundary-crossing pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-'ādiyāti}}) is the first content word of the oath, and it names a class by action rather than by species: the charging or running ones. Its genitive case makes that moving class the sworn-by object, while the feminine plural and definiteness make the group recognizable without forcing the reader to choose horses, camels, warriors, or another referent at this layer. The root {{ar:ع د و}} ({{tr:'-d-w}}) selects motion here, but its enemy, aggression, and exceeding-bounds field keeps the rush from sounding neutral. The variant {{ar:ٱلْغَادِيَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ghādiyāti}}) would move the line toward dawn-going, so the standard wording foregrounds charge before time; then the long ā and extended -iyāt ending let the rush stretch before the compact breath-word, while the feminine participial form sets the template for the next oath participles (100:2; 100:3).

words.gloss_range: an indefinite accusative verbal noun marking the runners' panting or hard-breathing manner/state; harsh cry and heat-scorching pressure remain secondary, locally narrowed by the oath scene and following spark image
words.prose: {{ar:ضَبْحًۭا}} ({{tr:ḍabḥan}}) closes the ayah as an indefinite accusative verbal noun, making the runners' hard breathing their manner or state rather than a second event. Its tanwin keeps that breath unbounded, spread through the charge rather than counted as one named sound. Its rarity matters: with no other supplied Quranic occurrence, local grammar, sound, lexicon, and the oath sequence carry the interpretive load. The primary sense is panting breath, while the root {{ar:ض ب ح}} ({{tr:ḍ-b-ḥ}}) also preserves harsh cry and scorching pressure, so the breath feels hot and effortful before the sparks of the next oath image (100:2). The emphatic ḍād, stop bā, and final ḥā make the closing word feel like rough exhalation after the longer rush. The variant {{ar:صُبْحًا}} ({{tr:ṣubḥan}}) would make the same slot a dawn-time expression and anticipate the explicit dawn term later in the sequence (100:3); the standard wording instead leaves the first ayah on sound, effort, and heat.
